serve_gate: At T+24 if active and zero impressions: exact statuses, policy, RSA/Ad strength, quality components, keywords/volume, bid/first-page diagnostic, geo/language, URL and measurement; same-day repair proposal rather than blind bid increase
stop_gate: Parent must bind owner-approved monetary loss cap and review delay before any launch. At half CPA allowance with no useful qualified signal, review/hold; at CPA allowance without attributed purchase, stop/narrow under explicit authority. Any hard CPC, landing, routing or measurement breach stops dependent spend actions. No statistical failure claim from a tiny test.
scale_gate: Verified purchases and net value after attribution lag/refund reserve; CPA at or below product-country allowance, ROAS at least max(6.5,1/allowable_ad_share), minimum30% all-cost profit. Multiple independent purchase outcomes and reviewer pass; one purchase alone does not validate scale.
profit_formula: Use booked merchandise AOV after discounts, before refunds, excluding collected taxes: allowable_ad_share = 1 - non_ad_non_return_cost_rate - incremental_return_loss_rate - 0.30; target_CPA = booked_AOV * allowable_ad_share; required_CVR = actual_CPC / target_CPA. Alternatively use fully reconciled realized contribution and its matching net-revenue base; never subtract refunds already removed from that base. Unknown inputs block a live budget decision.
